name: Revolut Merchant (Revolut Business)

webhook.algorithm: BEST-IN-CLASS AND FULLY VERIFIED. Header `Revolut-Signature` with value `v1=<hex>`; separate header `Revolut-Request-Timestamp` carries the event time in MILLISECONDS since epoch (e.g. 1683650202360). Signed payload = `v1` + `.` + timestamp + `.` + raw body, joined by full stops; HMAC-SHA256, hex-encoded, prefixed back as `v1=`. Documented tolerance: reject if Revolut-Request-Timestamp is more than 5 MINUTES from current UTC. `Revolut-Signature` may contain MULTIPLE comma-separated signatures while several signing secrets are active (rotation) — the verifier must accept if ANY matches, which n

credentials.note: Merchant API uses a secret API key as a Bearer token, with separate sandbox and production keys and distinct base URLs (sandbox-merchant.revolut.com vs merchant.revolut.com). Key prefix format NOT verified this pass — UNKNOWN.

onboarding.note: Business account approval precedes merchant API access.

fees.notes: UNKNOWN — not verified this pass. Revolut publishes merchant-account pricing per plan and region; do not emit a percentage.

notes: The cheapest credible card acceptance for EU/UK SMBs that already bank with Revolut Business, with same-account instant settlement instead of a T+2 payout cycle. Revolut Pay also converts unusually well for the large Revolut consumer base in CEE and the Baltics. Notably, its webhook design is the best-specified in this cluster and is the right template to copy.

SDKs: No first-party server SDKs of Stripe's calibre; Revolut publishes OpenAPI specs, a JS/Web checkout widget (@revolut/checkout) and mobile SDKs. Server-side is plain REST — generate a thin typed client.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps stripe on cards for EU/UK SMBs; unique on `revolut_pay` and on instant settlement into a business account.
Onboarding: application_review. Business account approval precedes merchant API access.
